findings.evidence: Lines 15–16 correctly give `I/P⁺`, whereas lines 69–70 claim a quotient of the ordinary class group; units already generate the trivial ordinary ideal class, and `sq_mem_totallyPositiveUnits` only concerns squares in `Kˣ`, not squares in the ordinary class group.
findings.fix: Describe `totallyPositiveUnits` as the kernel of the signature map on units (and part of the kernel measuring `Cl⁺ → Cl`), and remove the claim at lines 87–88 that this gives squares of ordinary ideal classes in the narrow class group.
findings.issue: The docstring incorrectly says the narrow class group is a quotient of the ordinary ideal class group by the image of `totallyPositiveUnits`; narrow classes instead quotient fractional ideals by principal ideals having totally positive generators, and map onto the ordinary class group.

summary: The formal definitions are sound, but the API documentation states an incorrect relationship between totally positive units and the narrow class group.
